verdict.rationale: Generating sound effects, ambient audio, or music is a fair question for an AI video creation tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers avatar voiceovers, voice cloning, dubbing with lip-sync, and motion graphics. Uploading your own custom script audio through the Upload API is a user-side workaround for narration, not generated scene-matched SFX or music, so it earns no credit.
